title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在京隆重举行
title_en: Celebration Meeting for the 105th Anniversary of the Founding of the Communist Party of China Held in Beijing
summary_zh: 7月1日上午，庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平发表重要讲话。
summary_en: On the morning of July 1, a celebration meeting for the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech.
